testing_principle: Every test states what it proves and what it does not prove. Passing tests must never be inflated into unsupported trust claims.

test_groups.name: Local Scaffold Validation
proves: Local continuity objects can be classified and settled.
Local trace can return accepted objects only.
Required scaffold files and sample outputs exist.

test_groups.name: Orchestration Contract Validation
proves: Layer, domain, template, receipt, roadmap, test, and management contracts parse.
Core loop templates exist.
Domains include proof obligations, authority ceilings, settlement rules, and fission triggers.
does_not_prove: That every future domain is fully implemented.
That generated governance decisions are automatically correct.

test_groups.name: Live MongoDB Atlas Proof
proves: Contest Atlas credentials can reach MongoDB from the local environment.
dAimon can seed continuity objects, receipts, queue entries, and sessions.
MongoDB-backed trace artifacts preserve accepted-only inheritance.

test_groups.name: Google Cloud Runtime Proof
proves: A contest runtime is deployed on Google infrastructure.
Runtime can answer health and trace requests.
Deployment facts can be receipted.

test_groups.name: Gemini or Agent Builder Handoff Proof
required_env: Configured Gemini or Agent Builder endpoint
commands: handoff script or manual API call to be added in P5
proves: Receipt-cleared context can be handed to a Gemini-era carrier.
Carrier output returns as candidate transition.
Settlement remains required before inheritance.
does_not_prove: Complete Google Agent Builder product integration.

test_groups.name: Google User And Tester Access Readiness
proves: Runtime proof is separated from individual human/tester access proof.
Cloud Run invocation is public or directly granted to target principals.
Target principals have direct Vertex AI user/admin access for Agent Engine use.
does_not_prove: That public Cloud Run access is the final release posture.

test_groups.name: Secret and Boundary Checks
proves: Obvious raw secret patterns are not present in tracked content.
Release diff is understood before push.
does_not_prove: Absence of all possible sensitive data.

test_groups.name: Self-Demonstrating Video Claim Audit
proves: Demo claims map to proof artifacts or are marked roadmap/non-claim.
The video package demonstrates dAimon governing its own demo.
does_not_prove: That the full enterprise product exists.
That external integrations not shown are complete.

test_groups.name: Partner Adapter Registry Validation
proves: MongoDB, Arize, Elastic, Fivetran, and GitLab are represented as governed context surfaces.
Each partner declares capabilities, authority boundary, proof obligations, evidence, next gate, and non-claims.
MongoDB remains the primary live proof while other partner lanes are marked planned.
does_not_prove: Live Arize, Elastic, Fivetran, or GitLab integration.
That partner data may be inherited without settlement.

test_groups.name: Technology Fabric Adapter Validation
commands: adapter manifest validation fixture to be added in P8
cross-surface path settlement fixture to be added in P8
proves: An adapter declares readable objects, writable objects, authority requirements, proof returned, and risk.
External objects normalize into candidate continuity objects.
Cross-surface lineage can be recorded without granting automatic trust.
does_not_prove: All listed technology classes are implemented.
That adapter data is inherently true.

test_groups.name: Portable Continuation Replay
commands: portable context package fixture to be added in P7
continuation replay fixture to be added in P7
proves: Receipt-cleared context can be packaged for another carrier.
Excluded witness and caveats remain visible.
Carrier return remains candidate until settlement.
does_not_prove: A production custom GPT connector exists.
All future carriers can consume the package.

test_groups.name: Voice Misrecognition Safety Gate
commands: voice risk phrase fixture to be added in P9
confirmation receipt fixture to be added in P9
proves: High-risk voice-derived phrases are detected.
Ambiguous or dangerous-looking voice packets pause for confirmation.
No high-risk action executes before confirmation.

test_groups.name: Project Identity And Collaboration Scope
commands: first contact package fixture to be added in P7
project pairing fixture to be added in P7
collaboration scope fixture to be added in P7
proves: A project ID can route work without granting full authority.
Pairing proof can upgrade a project lane to bounded packet authority.
Collaborator roles and capability scopes can be receipted.

test_groups.name: Security Red-Team Lab Containment
commands: threat model fixture to be added in P9
synthetic secret fixture to be added in P9
containment receipt fixture to be added in P9
proves: High-risk security scenarios are separated into lab lanes.
Synthetic secrets and sandbox targets are required for red-team fixtures.
Incident findings produce containment receipts and re-test requirements.
